comment: Copperbell Mines trash (BNpcBase 1421): 1051 HP, level 17; auto-attack 872 every 3.0 s, 399 every 27.8 s (a 2.2 s cast that hit nobody), 400 on itself once (status 53 at 50). From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Copperbell Mines (2026-10-25): one run with Duty Support (bd298651, visit 0.5) and two Duty Finder runs (69bea0b9, visits 0.1 and 0.3), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
